notes.title: HotFix 1.9.1
notes.content:
We are close to the final version, thank you for your support.
After the futur and last bug fix and update, PVE finalisation and new map and mod with it, the game will be over ! Please dont forget, I worked alone on him.

All Updates and bugfix are directly from the launcher.

1.9.1 Fix :

_Disconnect kill fix
_XP in PVE fix (headshot disable)
_Coutdown fix (only for the host)
_Upgrade Rank fix (not for the Heavy, i dont know why for the moment)
_Bunker PVP spawn zombies disable

notes.title: New Day and Night System
notes.content:
Hi everybody. I'm happy to announce that the development of the game is moving forward, I have just designed a new system of day and night to correct problems of night shadows. For the moment the new system is only available on the "Dock_Large" map in PVE or PVP. You can preview [url=https://youtu.be/tH4k5XTduic]here[/url]. Thank you
